skill_name: Design a T-shirt logo for a school's sports team.
workflow: This design comprises of a curved banner at the top with the words "Valley High School" in bold lettering and the team name, "The Eagles", in smaller letters beneath it. In the center of the design is a fierce-looking eagle, wings spread wide and claws outstretched, with fierce golden eyes and sleek feathers. Underneath the banner is a large home plate with the number "1" in the center.
